subject.title: fix(claude-cli): max-turn stops omit run and recovery context

question: Should a structured Claude CLI max-turn terminal result bypass both profile rotation and configured model fallback because tool effects may already have occurred?
rationale: The patch deliberately overrides existing fallback behavior to avoid duplicate effects; source and upstream contracts establish the condition but cannot settle OpenClaw's replay policy.

options.title: Make max-turn non-replayable
options.body: Surface the actionable error immediately and require an explicit retry after the user verifies possible tool effects.

options.title: Honor configured fallback
options.body: Keep existing replay behavior and accept that another profile or model may repeat tool actions after the Claude CLI limit.

recommendation.title: Make max-turn non-replayable
recommendation.body: Surface the actionable error immediately and require an explicit retry after the user verifies possible tool effects.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the shared terminal-reason behavior across both affected Claude CLI executor paths.
